highlights: The picker fix from 5.5.0 now covers the rest of the app. Appearance, Accent and Density in Display, Import Mode in Import & Export, and Type, Minimum Severity and Security in the integration editor were still cutting their value down to an ellipsis at accessibility text sizes — "Compact", "Default", "System", "Merge", "Webhook" and "Warning". Every picker in DomainDig now puts the value on its own line at those sizes instead. Below accessibility sizes nothing changes.
